title: 💼 Jobs (профессии) & Present Continuous (действия сейчас)
description: Учим названия профессий, учимся говорить о том, что люди делают прямо сейчас. Мемы, факты и любимые блогеры! 👩‍💻

grammar.title: Jobs and Professions
grammar.rule:
📘 **Профессии в английском языке**:

👨‍🏫 **teacher** — учитель
👨‍⚕️ **doctor** — врач
👩‍🍳 **cook** — повар
👨‍✈️ **pilot** — пилот
👩‍🚀 **astronaut** — космонавт
🧑‍💻 **programmer** — программист
👩‍🎨 **artist** — художник
👨‍🔧 **mechanic** — механик
👩‍💼 **businesswoman** — бизнес-леди

📝 **Суффиксы профессий**:
• -er: teacher, driver, painter, writer
• -or: doctor, actor, director
• -ist: artist, scientist, dentist
• -ian: musician, librarian, politician

🎯 **Мем**: My mum is a teacher. She always says: 'I don't have a favourite student... but if I did, it would be you!' 😅

vocabulary.example: My dad works as a doctor.
My brother wants to be a programmer.
He is a musician. He plays the guitar.
vocabulary.context_example: Он музыкант. Он играет на гитаре.

exercises.question: A programmer writes code for computers. 💻
exercises.explanation: Yes! Programmers write code for computers! 💻

grammar.title: Word formation: suffixes -er, -or, -ist, -ian
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как образуются названия профессий**:

📌 **-er**: teach → teacher, drive → driver, paint → painter
📌 **-or**: act → actor, direct → director, visit → visitor
📌 **-ist**: art → artist, science → scientist, piano → pianist
📌 **-ian**: music → musician, library → librarian, politics → politician

🎯 **Лайфхак**:
• Если глагол заканчивается на -e → убираем -e и добавляем -er: dance → dancer
• Если глагол заканчивается на согласную + y → y → i + er: fly → flier
• Но есть исключения!

vocabulary.example: A driver drives a car or a bus.
A baker makes bread and cakes.
I go to the dentist twice a year.
vocabulary.context_example: Я хожу к стоматологу два раза в год.

vocabulary.example: An actor performs in films and plays.
vocabulary.context_example: Актёр снимается в фильмах и играет в театре.

exercises.question: A ___ makes bread and cakes. 🍞 (baker / builder)
exercises.explanation: A baker makes bread and cakes! 🍞

exercises.question: A dentist looks after your teeth. 🦷
exercises.explanation: Yes! A dentist looks after your teeth! 🦷

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — Present Continuous (what is happening now)
days.description: Учимся говорить о том, что происходит прямо сейчас

grammar.title: Present Continuous — действия сейчас
grammar.rule:
📘 **Present Continuous**:

Мы используем Present Continuous, когда говорим о том, что ПРОИСХОДИТ ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС.

📝 **Формула**:
✅ am/is/are + глагол + -ing

📌 **Утверждение**:
✅ I am reading a book.
✅ He is playing football.
✅ They are watching TV.

📌 **Отрицание**:
❌ I am not reading.
❌ He isn't playing.
❌ They aren't watching.

📌 **Вопрос**:
❓ Are you reading?
❓ Is he playing?
❓ Are they watching?

🎯 **Мем**:
'What are you doing right now?'
'I'm reading this lesson. And I'm trying not to fall asleep!' 😅

vocabulary.example: I am reading a book right now.
My dad is working on his laptop.

exercises.question: What are you doing right now? 🧐
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous: I am reading! 📖

exercises.question: He ___ (play) football now. ⚽
exercises.explanation: He is playing — он играет прямо сейчас! ⚽

exercises.question: 'I am work' is a correct Present Continuous sentence.
They ___ (not / watch) TV right now. 📺
exercises.explanation: They are not watching — отрицание в Present Continuous! 📺

days.title: Day 4: Reading — What is Everyone Doing?
days.description: Читаем текст о том, что делают люди в данный момент

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди, кто что делает в данный момент.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на глаголы в Present Continuous (am/is/are + -ing)!

exercises.question: What is Leo doing right now? 💻
exercises.explanation: Leo is doing his Maths homework. 'Why is life so unfair?' 😅
exercises.readingText:
🌟 WHAT IS EVERYONE DOING RIGHT NOW? 🌟

It's 7 pm on a Tuesday evening. Everyone is busy! Let's see what the Johnson family and their friends are doing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📺 MUM AND DAD
Mum is watching her favourite TV show. She is laughing at something funny. Dad is reading a newspaper on the sofa. He is looking very relaxed. 📰

📚 LEO
Leo is in his room. He is doing his Maths homework. 'Why is life so unfair?' he says. He is not having fun! 😅

🎨 MIA
Mia is in her room too. She is drawing a picture of a cat. She is listening to music on her headphones. She is very focused! 🎧

🎮 SAM
Sam is on the phone with his friend. They are playing video games together. He is shouting 'YES!' because he is winning! 🎮

🍕 GRANDMA
Grandma is in the kitchen. She is cooking pizza for everyone. It smells amazing! 🍕

🐱 LUNA (the cat)
Luna is sleeping on Leo's bed. She is dreaming about something. Probably about fish! 🐟

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕒 8 PM — DINNER TIME!

Mum is calling everyone to the table. 'Dinner is ready!' she shouts.

Leo is running to the kitchen. He is hungry!

Mia is putting her drawing away.

Sam is telling his friend he'll call back later.

Dad is closing his newspaper.

Everyone is gathering around the table. Grandma is bringing the pizza. 🍕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 WHAT ABOUT YOU?
What are you doing right now? Are you reading this lesson? 😄

exercises.question: What is Mia doing? 🎨
exercises.explanation: Mia is drawing a picture of a cat! 🎨

exercises.question: Dad is cooking dinner.
exercises.explanation: Dad is reading a newspaper. Grandma is cooking! 🍕

exercises.question: Sam is winning at his video game.
exercises.explanation: Sam is shouting 'YES!' because he is winning! 🎮

exercises.question: Luna the cat is ___ on Leo's bed. 🐱
exercises.explanation: Luna is sleeping on Leo's bed! 🐱💤

days.title: Day 5: Present Continuous Practice
days.description: Тренируем Present Continuous в вопросах и ответах

grammar.title: Present Continuous — вопросы и ответы
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как задавать вопросы в Present Continuous**:

❓ **Am** + I + глагол-ing?
❓ **Is** + he/she/it + глагол-ing?
❓ **Are** + you/we/they + глагол-ing?

📝 **Краткие ответы**:
✅ Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
✅ Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
✅ Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

🎯 **Примеры**:
❓ Are you reading this?
✅ Yes, I am!

❓ Is your mum cooking dinner?
✅ Yes, she is! (Or maybe ordering pizza? 🍕)

exercises.question: ___ she cooking dinner? 🍳 — Yes, she is.
'Are they playing football?' — 'Yes, they are.' is correct.
___ you watching TV right now? 📺 — No, I'm not.

days.title: Day 6: Writing — What is Everyone Doing?
days.description: Пишем текст о том, что делают люди в данный момент

grammar.title: Повторение: Present Continuous
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ Выбери момент времени (например, сейчас, в данный момент).
2️⃣ Опиши, что делают разные люди.
3️⃣ Используй Present Continuous (am/is/are + -ing).
4️⃣ Добавь детали: где, когда, почему.

🎯 **Пример**:
It's 8 pm. Mum is cooking dinner in the kitchen. Dad is reading a newspaper on the sofa. I am doing my homework in my room. My sister is playing with her toys. My dog is sleeping under the table.

exercises.question: Mum ___ (cook) dinner in the kitchen. 🍳
exercises.explanation: Mum is cooking — мама готовит прямо сейчас! 👩‍🍳

exercises.question: I ___ (do) my homework in my room. 📚
My sister ___ (play) with her toys. 🧸
exercises.explanation: My sister is playing — сестра играет! 🧸
